players.product: EDA software and chip design simulation tools; chip design SuperAgent co-developed with NVIDIA

quarterly_data.signal: Cadence's second-quarter 2026 earnings release: Core EDA revenue grew 18% year-over-year on demand for its AI portfolio and expanded adoption across hyperscalers, top semiconductor companies and startups; System Design and Analysis revenue grew 37% year-over-year on adoption of its PCB and advanced packaging solutions and the integration of the Hexagon D&E business; Hardware had another record quarter, adding 12 new customers. Revenue mix by product category in Q2 2026: Core EDA 68%, Semiconductor IP 15%, System Design and Analysis 17%.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026: Core EDA revenue +18% YoY; System Design and Analysis revenue +37% YoY; Hardware 12 new customers; mix Core EDA 68%, Semiconductor IP 15%, System Design and Analysis 17%

quarterly_data.signal: Cadence's company-wide outlook in the release and CFO commentary: third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.595 billion - $1.625 billion, and fiscal year 2026 revenue in the range of $6.26 billion to $6.34 billion.
